name.description: The full name of the user

address.description: Array of addresses associated with the user.

phone.description: Array of phone numbers associated with the user.

email.description: Array of e-mail addresses associated with the user.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the user in the format YYYY-MM-DD

taxId.description: The user's government issued tax ID e.g. SSN (US) or SIN (CA)

deceased.description: If `true`, then the user is deceased.

eligible.description: Indicates if the user has got a successful result in all verifications and is eligible.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing the time the User Object was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp representing the time the User Object was last updated.

country.description: 2 character ISO Country code. Currently only the US is supported.

Address2Country.description: 2 character ISO Country code. Currently only the US is supported.
Address2Country.title: Address2Country

number.description: The driver's license number. Even though this field is called 'number', it may contain non-numeric characters if the country allows that.

title.description: The title of a given full name.

firstName.description: The first name of a given full name.

middleName.description: The list of middle names of a given full name.

lastName.description: The last name of a given full name.

suffix.description: The suffix of a given full name.

SegmentedName.description: The segmented version of a given name.
